evidence: For image features, we extract Faster R-CNN features with ResNet-101 backbone trained on Visual genome BIBREF4 dataset, similar to BIBREF2. We use an adaptive number of object proposals per-image ranging from 10 to 100 generated using a fixed confidence threshold and each object is then associated with 2048-dimensional mean-pooled features using ROI pooling. We use discriminative decoding throughout our models.
